verdict.rationale: The only usage-related evidence is the 100 GB/month free-ingest allowance and a community mention of a 'Data Management Hub' with log settings for turning off ingest. That hints at some ingest management but shows no spend view. Users also report ingest-driven bill increases they only caught afterwards. missing for 10: a documented view of observability spend or usage, cost attribution to teams or services, usage-spike or budget alerting, and any first-party docs on cost or usage management.
